items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: And when they say old man handy, was the daddy he was.

ctx.x: And from then on, everybody took breaks in blues. Yeah. But the Memphis blues was the first one. And when they say old man handy, was the daddy he was. Mm-hmm.
Do you remember any of the other early colored bands? There was one famous band, Buddy Bolden.
